name: Home leaderboard renders three agent rows in rank order
description: On https://codercup.ai, the leaderboard section shows three agent rows (Anti-Gravity, Claude Code, Codex). The first row's rank cell starts with '01'.

Scroll down to the Leaderboard section
In the leaderboard table, verify three agent rows are present and the top row's rank cell shows 01 with agent name Anti-Gravity

name: Home hero shows public-leaderboard headline and view-leaderboard CTA
description: The hero of https://codercup.ai shows the 'A public leaderboard' headline and a primary CTA whose label includes 'View the leaderboard'.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai
Verify the hero shows the heading text 'A public leaderboard' and a primary call-to-action button labelled 'View the leaderboard'

name: Clicking leaderboard arrow opens the agent detail page
description: From the home leaderboard, clicking the top agent row navigates to that agent's detail page, which shows a Score breakdown section with three sub-cards (Correctness, Bugs caught, Efficiency).

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai
Scroll down to the Leaderboard section
Click the top leaderboard row labelled Anti-Gravity to open its agent detail page
Verify the agent detail page heading reads Anti-Gravity and the Score breakdown section contains three labels: Correctness, Bugs caught, Efficiency

name: Home methodology section explains the composite formula
description: The Methodology section on https://codercup.ai surfaces the composite formula with weights 0.5 correctness, 0.3 bugs, 0.2 efficiency.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai
Scroll down to the Methodology section under the heading 'How we score'
Verify the Methodology section displays the composite formula text including the three weights 0.5 correctness, 0.3 bugs, 0.2 efficiency

name: Home task block shows world-cup-2026-v3 task slug and a deploy link
description: The task block (Event 001) on https://codercup.ai shows the task slug world-cup-2026-v3 and an external 'Open app' link pointing at an amplifyapp.com host.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai
Scroll down to the Event 001 task block section
In the task block on the right side, verify that an external 'Open app' link is present and its visible hostname contains 'amplifyapp.com'

name: Home leaderboard sub-score numbers render as three-decimal numbers
description: Each leaderboard row on https://codercup.ai shows the composite as a three-decimal number (e.g. 0.750), not a placeholder.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai
Scroll to the Leaderboard table
In the top row of the leaderboard table, verify the composite cell renders a numeric value of the form 0.XXX with three digits after the decimal point, not a dash or placeholder

name: Home top nav links to Events, Agents, Tests, Live pages
description: The top nav on https://codercup.ai has labels Leaderboard, Events, Agents, Tests, Live; clicking the Agents link lands on a page whose H1 mentions 'Every entrant'.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai
In the top navigation, click the link labelled Agents
Verify the resulting page URL path is /agents and the page heading contains the text 'Every entrant'

name: Agents index lists three shipped agent cards with vendor labels
description: The /agents page lists Anti-Gravity, Claude Code, and Codex cards; the Anti-Gravity card includes its vendor label Google.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents
Scroll down to the agent grid below the head-to-head canvas
Verify three agent cards are present: one for Anti-Gravity, one for Claude Code, one for Codex. Confirm the Anti-Gravity card shows the vendor text 'Google'

name: Agents index card composite numbers match three-decimal format
description: On /agents, each agent card shows its composite score as a three-decimal number like 0.750 inside the card body.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents
Scroll to the agents-grid section
Verify the first agent card (Anti-Gravity) displays a composite numeric value of the form 0.XXX with three digits after the decimal and the literal label 'composite' next to it

name: Clicking an agent card opens the agent profile page
description: From /agents, clicking the Anti-Gravity card navigates to /agents/antigravity where the page heading reads Anti-Gravity.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents
Click the agent card titled Anti-Gravity
Verify the page URL path is /agents/antigravity and the primary page heading contains the text Anti-Gravity

name: Agents index vendor filter narrows to one card when Anthropic is selected
description: Clicking the 'anthropic' vendor filter chip on /agents reduces the visible agent cards so that only Claude Code (vendor Anthropic) remains.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents
Wait for the agent grid to render with three cards titled Anti-Gravity, Codex, and Claude Code
In the Vendor filter row, click the chip whose visible text is 'anthropic'
Wait 1 second for the filtered grid to re-render

After the filter is applied, verify the agent grid now contains exactly one card whose title is 'Claude Code' and does not contain a card titled 'Codex' or 'Anti-Gravity' anywhere in the agent-card region

name: Anti-Gravity profile shows score breakdown sub-cards and run history
description: The /agents/antigravity page displays a Score breakdown with three sub-cards (Correctness, Bugs caught, Efficiency) and a Run history section that lists at least one run row.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents/antigravity
Scroll down past the identity header
Verify the Score breakdown section contains three sub-cards labelled Correctness, Bugs caught, Efficiency, and the Run history section contains at least one row labelled antigravity-worldcup-phase-1

name: Anti-Gravity profile lists per-test verdicts via Correctness card
description: On /agents/antigravity, the Correctness sub-card includes a 'Failing' list naming at least one specific failing plan by name (not just a count).

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents/antigravity
Scroll to the Score breakdown section
Inside the Correctness sub-card, verify there is a 'Failing:' list that includes at least one human-readable plan name (such as 'Clicking a Group A team row' or 'Homepage shows a hero')

name: Anti-Gravity profile Open deployed app link points at the live Amplify host
description: The Open-deployed-app button on /agents/antigravity has an href whose hostname contains amplifyapp.com.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents/antigravity
Scroll down to the Deployed artifact section
Verify the 'Open deployed app' button in the Deployed artifact section has an href whose URL hostname contains 'amplifyapp.com'

name: Claude Code profile loads and shows commit metadata
description: The /agents/claude-code page shows an agent header heading Claude Code and a Run history row whose label contains 'claude-code-worldcup-phase-1'.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents/claude-code
Scroll down to the Run history table
Verify the page heading contains 'Claude Code' and the Run history table contains a row whose label includes 'claude-code-worldcup-phase-1'

name: Codex profile loads and shows OpenAI vendor in identity row
description: The /agents/codex page identifies the agent as Codex from OpenAI in the identity header.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents/codex
Verify the identity header contains the agent name 'Codex' and includes the vendor text 'OpenAI'

name: Tests index lists the phase-1 plan rows under category headings
description: The /tests page groups the phase-1 plans by category. The Routes section header is visible and at least one plan named 'Clicking a Round-of-16 cell' is listed under it.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/tests
Scroll past the hero down to the category list
Verify a section header labelled 'Routes' exists and inside it there is a plan row containing the text 'Clicking a Round-of-16 cell'

name: Tests index plan rows show priority pills like P0 or P1
description: On /tests, each listed plan row shows a priority pill (P0, P1, etc.) — not just a slug.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/tests
Scroll to the Routes category list
Verify the first plan row in the Routes section displays a priority pill whose text matches 'P0' or 'P1'

name: Tests index plan row links to its individual test detail page
description: Clicking the first plan row on /tests navigates to /tests/<id> where the page surfaces the same plan name as the row.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/tests
Scroll to the Routes category list
Click the first plan row in the Routes section (it should mention 'Clicking a Round-of-16 cell')
Verify the resulting page URL path starts with /tests/ followed by an id and the page body contains the text 'Clicking a Round-of-16 cell'

name: Tests index hero shows GitHub link to phase-1 suite
description: The /tests hero exposes a 'Browse on GitHub' link pointing at the codercup repo's phase-1 tests folder.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/tests

name: Events index lists World Cup 2026 card under Apps category

name: Events index card click opens the world-cup detail page

name: World Cup event detail lists nine phase deliverables
description: The /events/world-cup-2026 page surfaces a Deliverable requirements list with all nine phases (Landing, Match details, Predictions, Lineups, Analysis, News, Odds, i18n, Light/Dark).

name: World Cup event Standings section names the three entrants

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/events/world-cup-2026
Scroll to the Standings section heading
Verify the Standings section content names all three agents: Anti-Gravity, Codex, and Claude Code

name: World Cup event aside card shows Watch live broadcast link
description: The right-side aside on /events/world-cup-2026 has a 'Watch live broadcast' button that links to /live.

Locate the aside card titled 'Event status'
Click the link labelled 'Watch live broadcast'

name: Live page shows three racer cards for the three agents

name: Live page TestSprite panel lists named plans with priority pills

Scroll to the right-hand TestSprite panel
Verify the TestSprite panel contains at least one plan row whose visible plan name starts with the word 'Clicking' and shows a priority pill (P0, P1, P2, or P3) next to its category label

description: Clicking the Codex racer card on /live updates the Workspace panel header to show 'codex' as the current agent.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/live
Click the racer card titled Codex
Verify the Workspace panel header now displays the agent label 'codex' (the test-id workspace-current-agent should resolve to text containing 'codex')

name: Live page bottom CTA links to the selected agent's profile
description: The 'View … full profile' CTA at the bottom of /live links to /agents/<slug>; clicking it for Claude Code lands on /agents/claude-code.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/live
Confirm the Claude Code racer card is selected (default selection)
Scroll to the bottom CTA that reads 'View Claude Code's full profile'
Click that CTA

description: The /methodology page shows the composite formula with weights 0.5 correctness, 0.3 bugs, 0.2 efficiency.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/methodology

Wait for the agent grid to render with three cards titled Anti-Gravity, Codex, and Claude Code
In the Vendor filter row, click the chip whose visible text is 'google'
Wait 1 second for the filtered grid to re-render

name: Agents index vendor filter narrows to Codex when OpenAI is selected
description: Clicking the 'openai' vendor filter chip on /agents reduces the visible agent cards to the OpenAI entrant (Codex).

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/agents
Wait for the agent grid to render with three cards titled Anti-Gravity, Codex, and Claude Code
In the Vendor filter row, click the chip whose visible text is 'openai'. Do not click it again.

Verify the agent grid does NOT contain a card whose title is 'Anti-Gravity'

name: Live page renders cohort header
description: When a visitor loads the /live page, the page returns a 200 response and renders cohort or live broadcast copy in the page chrome.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /live
Wait for the page to finish loading
Verify the page renders text containing either 'Live' or 'Cohort' in the visible content

name: Live page shows at least one event row from the seed stream

Wait for the page to finish loading
Wait for the live stream panel to populate with events from the cohort-3 JSONL feed
Locate the stream rows under the cohort-3.jsonl header
Verify at least one event row is visible in the stream panel
Verify the visible row text references an agent slug such as 'claude-code', 'codex', or 'anti-gravity'

name: Live page renders an empty-state message when the stream has no events

Wait for the page to finish loading
Locate the stream panel body
Verify the stream panel renders an empty-state line containing the phrase 'hasn\u2019t started yet' or the word 'unavailable'
Verify the page does not display a JavaScript error overlay or blank chrome

name: Phase-2 rollout: /tests index shows phase 1 + phase 2 sections + permalinks category
description: After phase-2 rollout, /tests groups by phase: phase 1 (landing, 6 categories) and phase 2 (match details, 5 categories including 'Permalinks · 5'). At least one phase-2 plan name is rendered.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/tests
Wait 1 second for the test catalog to render
Verify a section heading or phase tag with the literal text 'Phase 1 · Landing page' is present on the page
Verify a section heading or phase tag with the literal text 'Phase 2 · Match details' is present on the page
Verify at least one category tag with the literal text 'Permalinks · 5' is present (phase-2-only category — its presence proves the catalog extended past phase 1)
Verify at least one plan row whose name text reads 'Sample match permalink loads with team names visible' is present and clickable (phase-2 plan)

name: Phase-2 rollout: /tests/76b70d4a phase-2 plan detail renders permalinks category + phase 2 pill
description: The phase-2 plan detail page resolves the test_id 76b70d4a (sample match permalink loads), shows the plan name as heading, CATEGORY · PERMALINKS pill, WORLD-CUP-2026-V3 · PHASE 2 pill, and per-agent verdict rows.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/tests/76b70d4a
Wait 2 seconds for verdicts to load from the agent fixtures
Verify the page heading text reads 'Sample match permalink loads with team names visible'
Verify a category pill with literal text 'CATEGORY · PERMALINKS' is present (phase-2 category — would not exist in phase-1 plan rendering)
Verify a suite pill with literal text 'WORLD-CUP-2026-V3 · PHASE 2' is present (phase indicator)
Verify the latest-cohort verdicts list shows at least 1 per-agent verdict row with the agent name 'Anti-Gravity' visible

name: Phase-2 rollout: home leaderboard renders per-phase pills + Phases shipped 02
description: On codercup.ai home, the leaderboard table replaces the prior synthetic 14-run trend column with per-phase pills derived from leaderboard.json's per_phase blocks. The launch-meta section shows 'Phases shipped 02 of 09'.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai
Wait 2 seconds for the leaderboard table to hydrate from leaderboard.json
Scroll to the section with id 'leaderboard'
Verify the leaderboard column header row contains the literal text 'Per-phase' (replaces the prior synthetic '14-run trend' header)
Verify at least one leaderboard row contains a phase pill with literal text starting with 'P1' (a per-phase pill rendered from leaderboard.json's per_phase blocks)
Verify at least one leaderboard row contains a phase pill with literal text starting with 'P2' (a per-phase pill rendered from leaderboard.json's per_phase blocks)
Verify the launch-meta section shows a row with the literal label text 'Phases shipped' followed by a numeric value '02'

name: Phase-2 rollout: /live eyebrow is dynamic + phase toggle re-scopes test rail
description: On codercup.ai/live the eyebrow text is derived from events.json (contains 'phases scored'). The TestSprite test rail has a Phase 2 toggle button tagged 'latest' that, when clicked, flips the catalog to phase-2 plans.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/live
Wait 3 seconds for the stream + agent fixtures to hydrate
Verify the eyebrow text contains the substring 'phases scored' (derived from events.json — proves the eyebrow is no longer hardcoded to phase 1)
Verify a Phase 2 toggle button is present with the literal text including both 'Phase 2' and 'latest' (the latest-phase badge on the toggle)
Click the toggle button whose label includes 'Phase 2'
Wait 1 second for the test rail to re-render with phase-2 plans
Verify the TestSprite panel header now contains the substring 'phase 2' indicating the active catalog flipped
Verify a test-rail row containing the literal plan name 'Sample match permalink loads with team names visible' is now present (phase-2 plan that would NOT appear in the phase-1 catalog)

name: Phase-2 rollout: event detail standings reads 'cumulative across 2 of 9 phases'
description: On codercup.ai/events/world-cup-2026, the Standings section header now carries the cumulative-across-N-phases tag once leaderboard hydrates; the aside shows '9 planned · 2 shipped'.

planSteps.description: Open https://codercup.ai/events/world-cup-2026
Wait 2 seconds for the page to render + leaderboard to hydrate
Verify the standings header text contains the literal substring 'cumulative across 2 of 9 phases' (proves the standings section reads phase-2-aware)
Verify the event-status aside shows the row 'Phases' with the literal value '9 planned · 2 shipped'
